nodes.name: isodate CLI (whole product)
nodes.purpose: The complete single-file command-line tool isodate.py. Wires argv -> arg parser -> clock -> formatter -> stdout, returning the correct exit code. End-to-end embodiment of the vision.
nodes.single_responsibility: Print the requested date/time line to stdout and return the correct exit code for the given argv.

output_artifact.description: An executable Python file build/isodate.py. Running `python3 build/isodate.py [flags]` prints one line and exits 0; bad flags print usage to stderr and exit non-zero.

inputs.name: now
inputs.description: The current instant from the clock provider.

inputs.name: rendered_line
inputs.description: Formatted date/time string ready to print.

outputs.name: stdout_line
outputs.description: The single date/time line printed on success.

outputs.name: exit_code
outputs.description: 0 on success; non-zero (argparse: 2) on bad flags.

contract.connects_to_parent_via: This IS the root. Its composed output (stdout line + exit code) is the product the vision asks for; the CLI main() function assembles C-003 (parse), C-001 (clock), C-002 (format), then prints.

auto_check.expected: End-to-end tests pass: default prints YYYY-MM-DD exit 0; --time and --utc --time append HH:MM:SS; --bogus exits non-zero with usage on stderr.

procedure: From the repo root run: python3 planning/preeng-unix/001-isodate-cli/build/isodate.py
human_test.expected_observation: First prints today's local date as YYYY-MM-DD; second prints a UTC `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` line; third prints a usage line to the terminal and reports a non-zero exit.
human_test.pass_criteria: All three observations hold exactly as described.

acceptance_criteria: No-flag run prints exactly one YYYY-MM-DD line and exits 0.
--utc --time prints a UTC `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` line and exits 0.
A bad flag exits non-zero and writes a usage message to stderr.
isodate.py imports only Python standard-library modules.

nodes.name: Clock provider
nodes.purpose: Supplies the current instant as a datetime. Accepts an optional fixed value so tests are deterministic. The single source of 'now' for the whole tool.
nodes.single_responsibility: Return the current instant as a datetime (local or UTC), honoring an injected fixed clock when provided.

output_artifact.description: A `now(utc: bool, fixed: datetime|None)` function in build/isodate.py. Calling it with a fixed datetime returns that exact datetime; otherwise the real current instant.

inputs.name: utc
inputs.description: If true, return the instant in UTC; else local.

inputs.name: fixed
inputs.description: Optional injected fixed instant for deterministic tests.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: A datetime: tz-aware UTC when utc=True, naive-local otherwise (or the injected fixed value).

contract.connects_to_parent_via: main() (C-000) calls now(utc=flags.utc) and passes the result to the formatter (C-002).

auto_check.expected: Clock tests pass: now(fixed=X) returns X; now(utc=True) returns a UTC tz-aware datetime; exit code 0.

procedure: From repo root run: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'planning/preeng-unix/001-isodate-cli/build'); import isodate, datetime; print(isodate.now(fixed=datetime.datetime(2020,1,2,3,4,5)))"
human_test.expected_observation: Prints `2020-01-02 03:04:05` (the injected fixed value), proving the clock is injectable.
human_test.pass_criteria: Output equals the injected fixed datetime exactly.

acceptance_criteria: now(fixed=X) returns exactly X (determinism under injection).
now(utc=True) returns a timezone-aware datetime in UTC.
now(utc=False) returns the local current instant.

nodes.name: Date/time formatter
nodes.purpose: Formats a datetime into the output string: always a YYYY-MM-DD date, optionally a space + HH:MM:SS time. Single shared formatter for default, --utc, --time and composed flags.
nodes.single_responsibility: Turn a datetime plus a with_time flag into the correct output string.

output_artifact.description: A `format_line(dt, with_time: bool)` function in build/isodate.py returning a string like '2026-06-05' or '2026-06-05 14:03:09'.

outputs.name: line
outputs.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS when with_time is true.

contract.connects_to_parent_via: main() (C-000) calls format_line(now, flags.time) and prints the returned string to stdout.

auto_check.expected: Formatter tests pass: date-only and date+time outputs match the expected strings for a fixed datetime; exit code 0.

procedure: From repo root run: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'planning/preeng-unix/001-isodate-cli/build'); import isodate, datetime; dt=datetime.datetime(2026,6,5,14,3,9); print(isodate.format_line(dt, False)); print(isodate.format_line(dt, True))"
human_test.pass_criteria: Both lines match exactly (date-only, then date + HH:MM:SS).

acceptance_criteria: format_line(dt, False) returns dt's date as YYYY-MM-DD.
Deterministic: same dt + flag always yields the same string.

nodes.name: Argument parser
nodes.purpose: Parses argv into a flags object {utc, time}. On unknown/bad flags it emits a usage message on stderr and forces a non-zero exit, per the argparse contract.
nodes.single_responsibility: Parse argv into validated flags, or exit non-zero with a usage message on bad input.

output_artifact.description: A `parse_args(argv)` function in build/isodate.py returning a Namespace with .utc and .time booleans; argparse handles usage/exit on bad flags.

outputs.name: usage_error
outputs.description: On bad input: usage to stderr and non-zero exit.

contract.connects_to_parent_via: main() (C-000) calls parse_args(argv) first; the returned flags drive the clock (C-001) and formatter (C-002) calls.

auto_check.expected: Parser tests pass: --utc/--time parse True; no flags parse False; bad flag raises SystemExit non-zero; exit code 0.

procedure: In a Python shell with build/ on sys.path: from isodate import parse_args
Call parse_args(["--utc"]) and parse_args(["--time"]) and parse_args([]) and read the Namespace
Call parse_args(["--bogus"]) inside try/except SystemExit and inspect the raised exit code
human_test.expected_observation: parse_args returns the right Namespace for valid flags; a bad flag raises SystemExit with a non-zero code (argparse prints usage to stderr).
human_test.pass_criteria: Valid flags yield correct utc/time booleans AND parse_args(["--bogus"]) raises SystemExit code != 0. Tested on the leaf function in isolation — NOT by running the assembled CLI (that is the root C-000 test).

acceptance_criteria: An unknown flag raises SystemExit with a non-zero code and writes usage to stderr.
